subject.title: fix: wire tailscale_authkey and set operator for serve mode

question: Should this installer automatically replace a different existing Tailscale operator with the `openclaw` service user during every role run?
rationale: Tailscale exposes a single local operator identity, so the current behavior trades automatic Serve enablement against an existing administrator's management access and the repository's scoped-privilege boundary.

options.title: Preserve existing operator
options.body: Set `openclaw` only when the operator is empty or already matches, and require explicit opt-in before replacing another user.

options.title: Always claim operator
options.body: Keep automatic replacement, but document the upgrade impact and provide live proof that the intended administrator workflow remains acceptable.

options.title: Split the fixes
options.body: Land auth-key auto-connect separately and defer Serve operator assignment until the privilege policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing operator
recommendation.body: Set `openclaw` only when the operator is empty or already matches, and require explicit opt-in before replacing another user.

likelyOwner.reason: The available current-main history ties this person most directly to the role structure and security-sensitive task area.
